events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, the iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair began in Bethel, New York, attracting over 400,000 people for '3 Days of Peace & Music'.

angles.name: Remembering Woodstock
angles.copy: Cast your mind back to the summer of '69. Today marks the anniversary of Woodstock, a legendary event that truly defined a generation. Which artists do you wish you'd seen on that stage?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The world mourned on this day in 1977 as the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away at his Graceland home.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: On this day in 1977, we lost a true legend. Remembering the unparalleled voice and charisma of Elvis Presley. His music lives on.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' formidable frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: A very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking, still relevant, and still sounding incredible. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis legend Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Wishing a very happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger.

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today is Global James Bond Day, marking the 1962 premiere of 'Dr. No', the first film in the iconic 007 franchise.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's Global James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred, naturally) to over six decades of 007. Which Bond actor or theme song is your all-time favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're remembering the extraordinary talent and enduring legacy of John Lennon. Imagine that.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: And now for something completely different... a very happy 87th birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, a true comedy giant.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the music world lost one of its most iconic and flamboyant performers, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Tribute to Freddie Mercury
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we said goodbye to the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, his stage presence, his sheer talent – truly one of a kind. Forever missed.
